segments.sn17.3:1.3: Bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarasmiṃ udakarahade mahākummakulaṃ ciranivāsi ahosi.
segments.sn17.3:1.4: Atha kho, bhikkhave, aññataro kummo aññataraṃ kummaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn17.3:1.5: ‘mā kho tvaṃ, tāta kumma, etaṃ padesaṃ agamāsī’ti.
segments.sn17.3:1.6: Agamāsi kho, bhikkhave, so kummo taṃ padesaṃ.
segments.sn17.3:1.8: Atha kho, bhikkhave, so kummo yena so kummo tenupasaṅkami.
segments.sn17.3:1.9: Addasā kho, bhikkhave, so kummo taṃ kummaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.sn17.3:1.11: ‘kacci tvaṃ, tāta kumma, na taṃ padesaṃ agamāsī’ti?
segments.sn17.3:1.14: ‘Akkhato khomhi, tāta kumma, anupahato, atthi ca me idaṃ suttakaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhan’ti.
segments.sn17.3:1.16: Etena hi te, tāta kumma, suttakena pitaro ca pitāmahā ca anayaṃ āpannā byasanaṃ āpannā.
segments.sn17.3:1.17: Gaccha dāni tvaṃ, tāta kumma, na dāni tvaṃ amhākan’”ti.
segments.sn17.3:2.4: Yo hi koci, bhikkhave, bhikkhu uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ assādeti nikāmeti –
segments.sn17.3:2.5: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu giddho papatāya [bhikkhu papatāya (syā. kaṃ.), bhikkhu viddho papatāya (?)] anayaṃ āpanno byasanaṃ āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo pāpimato.
segments.sn17.3:2.6: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe …

lines: Agamāsīti “ettha addhā kiñci khāditabbaṃ atthi, taṃ maccharāyanto maṃ esa nivāretī”ti saññāya agamāsi.

Papatāyāti papatā vuccati dīgharajjukabaddho ayakantakosake daṇḍakaṃ pavesetvā gahito kaṇṇikasallasaṇṭhāno, ayakaṇṭako, yasmiṃ vegena patitvā kaṭāhe laggamatte daṇḍako nikkhamati, rajjuko ekābaddho gacchateva.
Yena so kummoti udakasaddaṃ sutvā sāsaṅkaṭṭhānaṃ bhavissatīti nivattitvā yena so atthakāmo kummo.
Na dāni tvaṃ amhākanti idāni tvaṃ amittahatthaṃ gato, na amhākaṃ santakoti attho.
Evaṃ sallapantānaṃyeva ca nesaṃ nāvāya ṭhito luddo rajjukaṃ ākaḍḍhitvā kummaṃ gahetvā yathākāmaṃ akāsi.
159-160. Aṭṭhikacchapā vuccanti yesaṃ kapālamatthake tikhiṇā aṭṭhikoṭi hoti, tesaṃ samūho aṭṭhikacchapakulaṃ.
Macchakacchapādīnaṃ sarīre lambantī papatatīti papatā, vuccamānākāro ayakaṇṭako.
